data.name: Lalman
data.long_meaning: Lalman is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Lal' meaning 'God' and 'Man' meaning 'of the universe'. In Hindu mythology, Lalman is a manifestation of Lord Vishnu and is worshipped for his cosmic powers. He is believed to be the protector of the universe and the sustainer of life.

The name Lalman is an invitation to the child to embody the divine qualities of the deity and to live a virtuous life.

Lord Vishnu is considered the preserver of the universe, and Lalman is his manifestation. By bearing this name, an individual is believed to be close to Lord Vishnu and is granted his blessings and protection. The name Lalman serves as a constant reminder of the divine presence and inspires one to live a life in alignment with the divine principles.
